## Dreamgirl analysis film ver and theatre version

This is the re-analysis for the dreamgirl dataset that was collected between 2017 to 2019, on various occasions, with two different stimuli - dreamgirls theatre, and dreamgirls film. And three testing set-up theatre - in theatre. Film - in groups and Film in isolated individuals.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(eyethinkphysiosync)
library(eyethinkdata)
library(tidyverse)
library(afex)
library(ggdist)
library(ggsignif)
library(explore)
library(gghalves)
library(GGally)
library(afex)
library(gtsummary)
library(MCMCglmm)
library(brms)
library(easystats)
library(rstanarm)
library(faintr)
library(emmeans)
library(corrplot)
library(ggside)
library(ggsignif)
library(psych)
library(ggsci)
library(lmerTest)
```

## IGNORE THIS SECTION get rw_means format

```{r}
rw_means_theatre =  rw_theatre %>% group_by(pid1, pid2, sgroup, pgroup, item) %>% summarise(DET_win = mean(DET, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(item != 'interval') %>%
  group_by(pid1, pid2, sgroup, pgroup) %>% summarise(DET_win = mean(DET_win, na.rm = TRUE))
    
```

```{r}
rw_means_film = rw_film %>% group_by(pid1, pid2, sgroup, pgroup, condition) %>% summarise(DET_win = mean(DET, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mutate(testing_occation = pgroup) %>% mutate(pgroup = ifelse(sgroup == 'in', condition, sgroup))
```

```{r}
rw_means_theatre$pid1 = as.character(rw_means_theatre$pid1)
rw_means_theatre$pid2 = as.character(rw_means_theatre$pid2)
rw_means_cbind1 = rbind(rw_means_theatre, rw_means_film)
```

```{r}
lmer(data = rw_means_film %>% filter(sgroup == 'in'), DET_win ~ testing_occation + (1|pid1)) %>% summary() 
```

```{r}
lmer(data = rw_means_cbind1 %>% filter(sgroup == 'in' & pgroup != 'journo'), DET_win ~ pgroup + (1|pid1)) %>% summary() 
```

```{r}
theatre_sr = read.csv('C:/Users/yuech/Desktop/Dreamgirl/audience_physiosync/dreamgirls_theatre/particpant_log.csv')
```

```{r}
pd_theatre_sr = left_join(pd_theatre %>% select(condition, item, pid, eid) %>% filter(item == 'act1'), theatre_sr %>% mutate(serial = toupper(serial)), by = c('condition' = 'session', 'eid' = 'serial')) %>% select(-item)
```

```{r}
pd_theatre_sr = left_join(pd_theatre_from_rw_mean_acts, pd_theatre_sr, by = 'pid')

```

```{r}
M = cor(pd_theatre_sr_encore[,2], pd_theatre_sr_encore[,c(14:38)], use = "complete.obs")

pd_theatre_sr_encore = pd_theatre_sr_encore %>% mutate(emo = (emo3+ emo4 + emo5), spiritual = (spiritual6 + spiritual7 + spiritual8), social = (social9 + social10 + social11 + social12), captivation = (captive1 + captive2))
M1 = cor(pd_theatre_sr_encore[,2], pd_theatre_sr_encore[,c(39:42)], use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}
film_sr = readxl::read_xlsx('C:/Users/yuech/Desktop/Dreamgirl/audience physio film ver/audience_physiosync/dreamgirls_movie/small groups 6 Dec 2018, Marian/participant_data.xlsx')
```

```{r}
film_sr = film_sr %>% mutate(pid = sub("(.*?\\w_\\w+)[\\[_].*", "\\1", pid))
```

```{r}
film_sr_clean = film_sr %>% select(pid, c(distracted:social12))
```

```{r}
pd_film_sr = left_join(pd_film_from_rw %>% filter(pgroup != 'out'), film_sr_clean, by = 'pid')
```

```{r}
pd_film_sr = pd_film_sr %>% mutate(testing_occation = pgroup, pgroup = ifelse(pgroup == '0', 'alone', 'group'))
```

```{r}
M2 = cor(pd_film_sr[pd_film_sr$pgroup == 'group',4], pd_film_sr[pd_film_sr$pgroup == 'group',c(18:29)], use = "complete.obs")
M2

M3 = cor(pd_film_sr[pd_film_sr$pgroup == 'alone',4], pd_film_sr[pd_film_sr$pgroup == 'alone',c(18:29)], use = "complete.obs")
M3
```

```{r}
pd_full_sr[pd_full_sr$pgroup != 'alone',c(2,4:28)] %>% scree(pc=F) # 3
```

```{r}
factanal(pd_full_sr[pd_full_sr$pgroup != 'alone',c(2,4:6,17:28)], factors = 3, scores='regression', rotation = 'promax') -> FA_mod1
```

```{r}
loadings(FA_mod1)
loadings = as.tibble(FA_mod1$loadings[,]) 
```

```{r}
loadings$Variable <- colnames(pd_full_sr[pd_full_sr$pgroup != 'alone',c(2,4:6,17:28)])  # Add variable names


# Convert to long format for ggplot
loadings_long <- loadings %>% pivot_longer(cols = -Variable, names_to = "Factor", values_to = "Loading")
```

```{r}
ggplot(loadings_long, aes(x = Variable, y = abs(Loading), fill = Loading)) +
  facet_wrap(~Factor, nrow = 1) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +  # Dodge = side-by-side bars
  labs(title = "Factor Loadings for Each Item", x = "Item", y = "Loading") +
  jtools::theme_apa() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +  # Rotate x-axis label
  scale_fill_gradient2(high = '#6f8278', mid = 'white', low = '#D15500', midpoint = 0) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c('#6f8278', '#D15500)) + 
  #scale_colour_manual(values = c('#6f8278','#F9AE78',, '#D15500')) + 
  coord_flip()

ggplot(loadings_long, aes(x = Factor, y = Variable, fill = Loading)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(title = "Factor Loadings Heatmap", x = "Factor", y = "Variable") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(loadings_long, aes(x = Factor, y = Loading, fill = Variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_polar() +  # Turns into a circular plot
  theme_minimal()
```

## result plot 1 here

```{r}
pd_full_both_sr_longer = pd_full_both_sr_longer %>% mutate(item = ifelse(item == 'distracted', 'focus', item))
pd_full_both_sr_longer$item <- factor(pd_full_both_sr_longer$item, levels = c("focus", "excitement", "confidentenjoy", 'emo','captive','spiritual','social'))

pd_full_both_sr_longer = pd_full_both_sr_longer %>% mutate(q_from = ifelse(item == 'focus'|item == 'excitement'|item == 'confidentenjoy', 'pre', 'post'))

pd_full_both_sr_longer = pd_full_both_sr_longer %>% mutate(condition = ifelse(condition == 'encore', 'theatre' , condition)) %>% mutate(condition = ifelse(condition == 'group', 'film co-watch' , condition))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = pd_full_both_sr_longer %>% filter((condition == 'theatre'|condition == 'film co-watch')), aes(x = item, y = response, colour = condition, fill = condition)) + 
  geom_half_violin(side = 'l', linewidth = 0,trim = FALSE, alpha = .7, position = position_nudge(x = -.1)) + stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se,
               geom = "pointrange", 
               linewidth = 0,
               position = position_nudge(x = -.1)) +
  stat_interval(alpha = .5, aes(color_ramp = after_stat(level)), 
                .width = c(.5, .95),
```

### New timecourse plot with HRS and raw HR
```{r}
ggplot(data = rw_cbind_old %>% filter(sgroup == 'in' & pgroup != 'alone') %>% mutate(category = recode(category, 'film' = 'film co-watch'), category = relevel(as.factor(category), 'film co-watch')), aes(x = win/20, y = DET, colour = category)) + geom_smooth(se = FALSE, formula = y ~ splines::ns(x, 16)) + 
  #jtools::theme_apa() +
  #geom_line(stat = 'summary', aes(y = DET, colour = category), linewidth = 1.2) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#51A3BC','#FF5F2E')) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#51A3BC', '#FF5F2E')) + ylab(label = 'HR synchrony') + xlab(label = 'Timecourse Window') +
  xlab(label = 'Minute') + theme_ggdist() + labs(colour = 'condition') + 
  #scale_y_continuous(
    #name = "HR synchrony",
    #sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = 'Raw HR')) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(70, 75)) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), axis.text = element_text(size = 18), legend.text = element_text(size = 18), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18), strip.text.x = element_text(size = 18), legend.position = 'top')

ggsave('timecourse HRS.png', width = 4000, height = 1500, units = 'px')

timecourse

```


```{r}
timecourse_rw <- rw_cbind_old %>% filter(sgroup == 'in' & pgroup != 'alone') %>% mutate(t = win * 3 - 3, minute = t %/%60, halfmin = t %/% 30, two_min = t %/% 120)  

timecourse_summary <- timecourse_rw %>% group_by(pid1, pid2, category, minute) %>% summarise(meanDET = mean(DET, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(pid1, pid2) %>% mutate(norm_meanDET = scale(meanDET))
```

get raw HR
```{r}
timecourse_raw <- raw_full %>% select(category, pid, raw, tt) %>% mutate(minute = tt %/%60, halfmin = tt %/% 30)

raw_tc_summary <- timecourse_raw %>% group_by(pid, category, minute) %>% summarise(meanHR = mean(raw, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(pid) %>% mutate(norm_meanHR = scale(meanHR))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = raw_tc_summary, aes(x = minute, y = meanHR, colour = category, fill = category)) + 
  geom_line(stat = 'summary', data = raw_tc_summary, aes(y = meanHR), alpha = .33, linewidth = 1.25) +
  geom_line(stat = 'summary', data = timecourse_summary, aes(y = meanDET, colour = category), linewidth = 1) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#51A3BC','#FF5F2E')) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#51A3BC','#FF5F2E')) + ylab(label = 'HR synchrony') + 
  xlab(label = 'Minute') + theme_ggdist() + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Raw HR",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = 'HR Synchrony')) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), axis.text = element_text(size = 18), legend.text = element_text(size = 18), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18), strip.text.x = element_text(size = 18))+
  xlim(0,125)

ggsave('timecourse new.png', width = 4000, height = 1500, units = 'px')
```
